sections.A: Rotator cuff repair mein phata tendon anchors aur tankon se haddi par wapas joda jata hai. Tendon aur haddi ka jurna aahista hota hai, is liye shuru mein hifazat zaroori hai.
sections.B: Tear ka size, kaun se tendons, tissue ki halat aur saath ki surgeries dekhein; yeh rehab ki raftaar badalte hain.
sections.G: Bukhar, zakhm ki laali ya paani (infection), ya achanak dard aur active movement khatam hona (repair phatna): surgeon ko batayein.
sections.H: Phase 1 hifazat (0-6 hafte), phase 2 active range (6-12 hafte), phase 3 taaqat, phase 4 kaam aur khel. Hamesha surgeon ki hidayat.
sections.J: Pendulum, doosre haath se passive elevation, table slides aur hadd ke andar wand external rotation, phir active aur taaqat.
sections.M: Range, taaqat, dard, Oxford Shoulder Score ya SPADI aur kaam dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Tendon aur haddi ka jurna is liye aahista hai kyunki wahan khoon ka supply kam hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
